sentences.text: Manmohan Singh -LRB- -LSB- mənˈmoːɦən ˈsɪ́ŋɡ -RSB- ; born 26 September 1932 -RRB- is an Indian economist and politician who served as the Prime Minister of India from 2004 to 2014 .	Prime Minister of India	Prime Minister of India
The first Sikh in office , Singh was also the first prime minister since Jawaharlal Nehru to be re-elected after completing a full five-year term .	Sikh	Sikh	Jawaharlal Nehru	Jawaharlal Nehru

Born in Gah -LRB- now in Punjab , Pakistan -RRB- , Singh 's family migrated to India during its partition in 1947 .	Gah	Gah, Pakistan	Punjab	Punjab Province (British India)	its partition	Partition of India
After obtaining his doctorate in economics from Oxford , Singh worked for the United Nations during 1966 -- 69 .

He subsequently began his bureaucratic career when Lalit Narayan Mishra hired him as an advisor in the Ministry of Foreign Trade .	Lalit Narayan Mishra	Lalit Narayan Mishra	Ministry of Foreign Trade	Ministry of Commerce and Industry (India)

Over the 70s and 80s , Singh held several key posts in the Government of India , such as Chief Economic Advisor -LRB- 1972 -- 76 -RRB- , Reserve Bank governor -LRB- 1982 -- 85 -RRB- and Planning Commission head -LRB- 1985 -- 87 -RRB- .	Government of India	Government of India	Reserve Bank	Reserve Bank of India	Planning Commission	Planning Commission (India)

In 1991 , as India faced a severe economic crisis , newly elected Prime Minister P. V. Narasimha Rao surprisingly inducted the apolitical Singh into his cabinet as Finance Minister .	P. V. Narasimha Rao	P. V. Narasimha Rao	economic crisis	1991 India economic crisis	Finance Minister	Minister of Finance (India)
Over the next few years , despite strong opposition , he as a Finance Minister carried out several structural reforms that liberalised India 's economy .	Finance Minister	Minister of Finance (India)

Although these measures proved successful in averting the crisis , and enhanced Singh 's reputation globally as a leading reform-minded economist , the incumbent Congress party fared poorly in the 1996 general election .	Congress party	Indian National Congress	1996 general election	1996 general election

Subsequently , Singh served as Leader of the Opposition in the Rajya Sabha -LRB- the upper house of India 's Parliament -RRB- during the Atal Bihari Vajpayee government of 1998 -- 2004 .	Atal Bihari Vajpayee	Atal Bihari Vajpayee	Leader of the Opposition in the Rajya Sabha	Leader of the Opposition (India)	Rajya Sabha	Rajya Sabha	Leader of the Opposition	Leader of the Opposition (India)

In 2004 , when the Congress-led United Progressive Alliance -LRB- UPA -RRB- came to power , its chairperson Sonia Gandhi unexpectedly relinquished the premiership to Manmohan Singh .	United Progressive Alliance	United Progressive Alliance	Sonia Gandhi	Sonia Gandhi

Singh 's first ministry executed several key legislations and projects , including the Rural Health Mission , Unique Identification Authority , Rural Employment Guarantee scheme and Right to Information Act .	first ministry	first Manmohan Singh ministry	Rural Health Mission	National Rural Health Mission	Unique Identification Authority	Unique Identification Authority of India	Rural Employment Guarantee	Mahatma Gandhi National Rural Employment Guarantee Act	Right to Information Act	Right to Information Act

In 2008 , opposition to a historic civil nuclear agreement with the United States nearly caused Singh 's government to fall after Left Front parties withdrew their support .	civil nuclear agreement with the United States	U.S.–India Civil Nuclear Agreement	Left Front	Left Front (West Bengal)

Although India 's economy grew rapidly under UPA I , its security was threatened by several terrorist incidents -LRB- including the 2008 Mumbai attacks -RRB- and the continuing Maoist insurgency .	2008 Mumbai attacks	2008 Mumbai attacks	Maoist insurgency	Maoist insurgency
The 2009 general election saw the UPA return with an increased mandate , with Singh retaining the office of Prime Minister .	2009 general election	Indian general election, 2009

Over the next few years , Singh 's second ministry government faced a number of corruption charges -- over the organisation of the Commonwealth Games , the 2G-spectrum allocation and the allocation of coal blocks .	second ministry	second Manmohan Singh ministry	2G-spectrum allocation	2G spectrum scam	allocation of coal blocks	Indian coal allocation scam

After his term ended in 2014 he opted out from the race to the office of the Prime Minister of India during 2014 Indian general election .	Prime Minister of India	Prime Minister of India	2014 Indian general election	Indian general election, 2014

Singh was never a member of the Lok Sabha but continues to serve as a member of the Indian Parliament , representing the state of Assam in the Rajya Sabha for the fifth consecutive term since 1991 .	Rajya Sabha	Rajya Sabha	Assam	Assam	member of the Lok Sabha	Member of parliament, Lok Sabha	Indian Parliament	Indian Parliament
